title: kitchen.orders.close_from_order
description: Payload of the `order.completed` event (contract of the sales module, ADR-0146): the ORDER is closed — fully charged and the table released — and its bumped rounds become served; rounds still waiting or cooking keep cooking (kitchen#145). additionalProperties=true on purpose: the event carries keys of its own (`sender`) and the relay delivers its payload AS IS; an `additionalProperties: false` here would send every delivery to the dead-letter without saying why (kitchen#29). Idempotent: a redelivery only sees terminal rounds and writes nothing.
